about: Generated mnemonics for kanji readings (pilot: JLPT N5). **meaning**, [[sound-alike]]; a doubled vowel marks a long one ([[co-o]]p for コウ). CC BY-SA 4.0, like the rest of the data.

日.ニチ: The **sun** shines into one [[niche]] every **day**: 毎日 (まいにち), every day.
日.ジツ: Jiu-[[jitsu]] class meets every **day**; signs say 本日 (ほんじつ) for "today".
日.-か: Counting **day**s on a [[ca]]lendar: 二日 (ふつか), 三日 (みっか).

一.イチ: **One** mosquito bite and you're [[itchy]] all night: いち.

国.コク: Every **country** sells [[Coke]]: 外国 (がいこく), a foreign country.
国.くに: Out in the **country**, a pigeon [[coo]]s on my [[knee]]: くに.

人.ジン: That **person** drinks [[gin]]: 日本人 (にほんじん), a Japanese person.
人.ニン: One **person** sneaks past, a [[nin]]ja: 三人 (さんにん), three people.

年.ネン: Every **year**, Grandma [[Nen]] bakes a cake: 来年 (らいねん), next year.
年.とし: Every **year** I stub my [[toe]], and [[she]] laughs: とし.

大.ダイ: A **big** vat of [[dye]]: someone dyed a whole university (大学, だいがく) in school colours.
大.タイ: Wear your **big** [[tie]] for big moments: 大切 (たいせつ), precious; 大変 (たいへん), tough.
大.おお.きい: "[[Oh]]!" you gasp at something **big**: おおきい.

十.ジュウ: **Ten** glasses of [[ju]]ice is plenty: 十分 (じゅうぶん), enough.

本.ホン: Cars [[hon]]k while I read my **book**: 日本 (にほん), Japan.

中.チュウ: [[Chew]] with your food **inside** your mouth: 中国 (ちゅうごく), China.

長.チョウ: The **leader** is the [[cho]]sen one: 社長 (しゃちょう), company president.

出.シュツ: Water [[shoots]] out of the **exit**: 出席 (しゅっせき), attendance.
出.で.る: Run for the **exit** at the [[de]]ntist: でる.
出.だ.す: [[Dash]] out and **put out** the trash: だす.

時.ジ: "[[Gee]], look at the **time**!" 時間 (じかん).
時.とき: [[Toe]] on the [[key]]: **time** to go. とき.

行.コウ: **Going** on a trip with the [[co-o]]p: 旅行 (りょこう).
行.ギョウ: [[Gyo]]za stalls stand in a **line**: 行列 (ぎょうれつ), a queue.
行.い.く: "[[Eek]], I'm late!" and off I **go**: いく.
行.おこな.う: "[[Oh]], [[Kona]]!" We **carry out** our plan to fly to Hawaii: おこなう.

見.ケン: [[Ken]] wants to **see** everything: 見学 (けんがく), a study visit.
見.み.せる: "**See** this? Show [[me]]!" みせる, to show; みる, to see.

月.ゲツ: Every **month** she [[gets]] paid: 今月 (こんげつ), this month.
月.ガツ: Naming a **month** takes [[guts]]: 一月 (いちがつ), January.

後.ゴ: [[Go]] **later**, after noon: 午後 (ごご), afternoon.
後.コウ: In the [[co-o]]p queue, I'm **behind** you: 後半 (こうはん), the second half.

前.ゼン: Find [[Zen]] **before** you begin: 午前 (ごぜん), morning.
前.まえ: "[[Ma]], [[eh]]?" Mum is standing **in front** of the TV: まえ.

生.セイ: A teacher (先生, せんせい) has a lot to [[say]] about **life**.
生.ショウ: A whole **life** is one long [[show]]: 一生 (いっしょう), a lifetime.
生.い.きる: **Life** gets [[icky]], but you live it: いきる.
生.う.まれる: "[[Ooh]], [[Mary]], a new **life** is born!" うまれる.

間.カン: A [[can]] fits in the **space** between: 時間 (じかん), time.
間.ケン: [[Ken]] leaves a **space** between words: 世間 (せけん), the world around us.
間.あいだ: [[Ida]] sits in the **space** between us: あいだ.

上.ジョウ: [[Jo]]e climbs **up** the ladder: 上手 (じょうず), skilful.

東.トウ: Stub your [[toe]] walking **east**: 東京 (とうきょう), Tokyo.
東.ひがし: Facing **east** at dawn, [[he]] says "[[gosh]]!": ひがし.

四.シ: [[She]] has **four** cats: 四月 (しがつ), April.

今.コン: A [[con]] artist only sells **now**: "This week only (今週, こんしゅう)!"
今.いま: Who are you **now**? "[[I'm]] [[a]] student." いま.

金.キン: My [[kin]] all want my **gold**: 金曜日 (きんようび), Friday.
金.かね: A **gold** [[ca]]r? [[Ne]]ver, too much money: かね.

九.キュウ: **Nine** balls racked; pick up the [[cue]]: きゅう.

入.ニュウ: **Enter** the [[new]] school: 入学 (にゅうがく).
入.い.れる: **Insert** a bud in your [[ear]]: いれる.

学.ガク: Students [[gawk]] while they **study**: 大学 (だいがく), university.
学.まな.ぶ: **Learning** is [[manna]] for the mind: まなぶ.

高.コウ: The [[co-o]]p built a **tall** tower: 高校 (こうこう), high school.
高.たか: A **tall** order: [[tuck]] [[a]] giraffe into bed! たかい.

円.エン: English says **yen**, but Japanese says just [[en]]: えん.

子.シ: [[She]] is a **child**: 女子 (じょし), girl.

外.ガイ: That [[guy]] is from **outside**: 外国 (がいこく), abroad.
外.そと: **Outside** in the snow, [[so]] my [[toe]]s freeze: そと.
外.はず.す: He [[has]] to take his coat off **outside**: はずす, to remove.

八.よう: On the **eight**h day, a long [[yo-o]]-yo string: 八日 (ようか).

六.むい: **Six** cows [[mooi]]ng on the sixth: 六日 (むいか).

下.カ: A [[ca]]r parked **below** ground: 地下 (ちか), underground.
下.ゲ: A [[ge]]cko hides **below**: 下水 (げすい), sewer.
下.さ.げる: The shelf [[sag]]s **down**: さげる, to lower.

来.ライ: [[Rye]] bread will **come** next year: 来年 (らいねん).
来.き: **Come** in, here's the [[key]]: 来て (きて).

気.キ: The [[key]] to a happy **spirit**: 元気 (げんき), healthy.
気.ケ: Your **spirit** senses [[ke]]tchup nearby: 気配 (けはい), a sign of something.

小.ショウ: A **small** [[show]]: 小学校 (しょうがっこう), primary school.
小.ちい.さい: A **small** piece of [[chee]]se: ちいさい.
小.こ-: A **small** [[co]]at for a small bird: 小鳥 (ことり).

七.なの: **Seven** [[nano]]seconds: 七日 (なのか), the seventh day.

山.サン: The [[sun]] rises over the **mountain**: 富士山 (ふじさん).

話.ワ: **Talk** on a [[wa]]lkie-talkie: 電話 (でんわ), phone.

女.ジョ: A **woman** out for a [[jo]]g: 女子 (じょし), girl.
女.おんな: D[[onna]] is a **woman**'s name: おんな.

午.ゴ: At **noon**, [[go]] to lunch: 午後 (ごご), afternoon.

百.ヒャク: [[He]] [[yak]]s a **hundred** times a day: ひゃく.

書.ショ: **Write** a list for the [[sho]]p: 辞書 (じしょ), dictionary.

先.セン: Every [[cen]]t paid **before** the month ends: 先月 (せんげつ), last month.
先.さき: Pack your [[sock]]s and [[key]]s **ahead** of time: さき.

名.メイ: Her **name** is [[May]]: 有名 (ゆうめい), famous.
名.な: "Your **name**?" "[[Nah]]." な, as in 名前 (なまえ).

水.スイ: [[Swee]]t **water**: 水曜日 (すいようび), Wednesday.

半.なか.ば: [[Knock]] **half**way down the hall, then [[ba]]ck off: なかば.

男.ダン: [[Don]] is a **male** name: 男子 (だんし), boy.
男.おとこ: "[[Otto]], [[co]]me here!" a **male** voice calls: おとこ.

西.セイ: [[Say]] goodbye to the **west**ern sun: 西洋 (せいよう), the West.
西.にし: Out **west**, [[knee]]-deep in the river, [[she]] waits: にし.

電.デン: **Electricity** hums in the [[den]]: 電車 (でんしゃ), train.

校.コウ: The [[co-o]]p runs the **school** canteen: 学校 (がっこう).

語.ゴ: Learn a **word** and [[go]]: 日本語 (にほんご), Japanese.
語.かた.る: A storyteller from [[Qatar]] gives a **speech**: かたる.

土.ド: [[Dough]] made of **soil**? 土曜日 (どようび), Saturday.
土.つち: Farmers get [[touchy]] about their **soil**: つち.

木.モク: Birds [[mock]] me from the **tree**: 木曜日 (もくようび), Thursday.

聞.ブン: **Hear** the news over a [[bun]]: 新聞 (しんぶん), newspaper.

食.ショク: What a [[shock]]: we **eat** here! 食堂 (しょくどう), dining hall.

車.シャ: A [[sha]]rk in a **car**: 電車 (でんしゃ), train.

南.みなみ: "[[Me]]? [[Nah]], [[me]]!" Everyone wants to go **south**: みなみ.

万.マン: **Ten thousand** people, every [[man]] counted: 一万 (いちまん).

毎.マイ: **Every** day is [[my]] day: 毎日 (まいにち).

天.テン: **Heaven** gets a [[ten]] out of ten: 天気 (てんき), weather.

母.ボ: **Mother** rows a [[bo]]at home: 母国 (ぼこく), homeland.

火.カ: A [[ca]]r on **fire**: 火曜日 (かようび), Tuesday.

右.ユウ: [[You]] turn **right**: 左右 (さゆう), left and right.

読.ドク: The [[doc]] **read**s your chart: 読書 (どくしょ), reading.

友.ユウ: [[You]] are my **friend**: 友人 (ゆうじん).

左.サ: [[Sa]]w off the **left** branch: 左右 (さゆう), left and right.
左.ひだり: [[He]] and [[Dari]]o drive on the **left**: ひだり.

休.キュウ: Lean on your [[cue]] and **rest**: 休日 (きゅうじつ), day off.

父.フ: **Father** brings home [[foo]]d: 父母 (ふぼ), parents.
